quests.instruction: Ben wakes up, eats breakfast, then goes to school. What comes right after breakfast?
quests.hint: Follow the order of his morning.
quests.explanation: After breakfast, Ben heads to school. The sequence goes from waking up, to breakfast, to school.
quests.funFact: Many children walk or ride a bus to get to school.

quests.instruction: A family finishes dinner, then takes a bath, then reads a story. What comes next?
quests.hint: Ask yourself what the bedtime routine builds toward.
quests.explanation: After dinner, bath, and a story, the next step is sleep, which closes the day.
quests.funFact: A calm bedtime routine can help you fall asleep faster.

quests.instruction: On a school day, which of these happens before the other?
quests.hint: You need to be awake before you can arrive at school.
quests.explanation: You wake up, get ready, and then travel to school, where the bell rings.
quests.funFact: Some alarm clocks gradually get louder to wake you gently.

quests.instruction: The Sun sets, the sky grows dark, and then what appears?
quests.hint: Follow what the changing sky does next.
quests.explanation: After sunset, the sky darkens and stars become easier to see.
quests.funFact: The first stars to appear at dusk are often the brightest.

quests.instruction: Put the evening in order: dinner, pajamas, sleep. What is in the middle?
quests.hint: The middle step is neither the first nor the last.
quests.explanation: Dinner comes first, then pajamas, and then sleep, so pajamas are in the middle.
quests.funFact: Putting on pajamas signals the body that it is time to rest.

quests.instruction: What usually happens right before the Sun rises?
quests.hint: Consider the minutes before sunrise.
quests.explanation: Before the Sun rises, the sky slowly begins to brighten, a time called dawn.
quests.funFact: Dawn is the soft light just before sunrise.

quests.instruction: Which sequence is correct?
quests.hint: Start with the beginning of the day.
quests.explanation: The day starts with sunrise, then lunchtime in the middle of the day, then sunset at the end.
quests.funFact: Every day follows this same cycle: sunrise, midday, then sunset.

quests.instruction: Maya packed her bag, put on her shoes, and walked out the door. What will she do after she arrives at school?
quests.hint: She is just starting her school day.
quests.explanation: After arriving, Maya goes to class, which comes early in the school day.
quests.funFact: In many schools, the first lesson begins soon after children arrive.

quests.instruction: Which comes first: lunch or afternoon recess?
quests.hint: One of them is a meal that sits near the middle of the day.
quests.explanation: Lunch comes in the middle of the day, and afternoon recess often follows later.
quests.funFact: Recess gives students time to rest and play.

quests.instruction: Which sequence shows a day from morning to night?
quests.hint: Find the one that moves from first light to last.
quests.explanation: Meals follow the time of day: breakfast, lunch, dinner, then bedtime at night.
quests.funFact: Many cultures put breakfast first and dinner last, though the foods are very different.

quests.instruction: A bee leaves the hive when the Sun is up, visits flowers, then returns to the hive when it gets dim. When does it go back?
quests.hint: The bee finishes its day's work as the light fades.
quests.explanation: Bees fly in the daytime and return to the hive at the end of the day, when it gets dim.
quests.funFact: A honey bee colony can contain tens of thousands of bees.

quests.instruction: The streetlights come on, then the Moon rises. Which comes just before the streetlights?
quests.hint: Streetlights come on when light is fading.
quests.explanation: Streetlights switch on when the Sun sets and the sky gets dark, so sunset comes before them.
quests.funFact: Before electricity, some towns had lamplighters who lit street lamps at dusk and put them out at dawn.

quests.instruction: Pick the order for waking up: open eyes, stretch, get out of bed. What is last?
quests.hint: Find the step that follows all the others.
quests.explanation: You open your eyes first, stretch next, and last you get out of bed.
quests.funFact: Stretching helps loosen muscles that stayed still for hours while you slept.

quests.instruction: Which comes before the school bell rings in the morning?
quests.hint: Picture getting to school on time.
quests.explanation: Walking to school happens before the morning bell. Lunch comes later in the day.
quests.funFact: The first school bells were rung by hand.

quests.instruction: Which comes next: sunrise, morning, midday, ...?
quests.hint: The day moves forward from midday.
quests.explanation: After midday comes the afternoon, followed by the evening and the night.
quests.funFact: Afternoon is the time between midday and evening.

quests.instruction: A girl hears a rooster, sees sunlight, and smells toast. What did she do just before?
quests.hint: She is waking up to a new day.
quests.explanation: She heard the rooster and saw sunlight, so she had just woken up.
quests.funFact: Many people say the smell of toast helps them wake up.

quests.instruction: Which of these happens last?
quests.hint: Notice the end of the day.
quests.explanation: Falling asleep is the last thing that happens in a day.
quests.funFact: While you sleep, your body keeps growing and your brain sorts through what you learned.

quests.instruction: Which comes right before bedtime?
quests.hint: One happens the moment the day starts, the other as it ends.
quests.explanation: Brushing teeth is part of the bedtime routine, which comes before sleep.
quests.funFact: Teeth can feel fuzzy when they are not brushed.

quests.instruction: Put these in order: the Sun sets, birds quiet down, the neighborhood falls asleep. What happens first?
quests.hint: The sky changes before the animals and people do.
quests.explanation: The Sun sets first. Then birds quiet down in the dim light, and later the neighborhood falls asleep.
quests.funFact: Birds often settle down to sleep at dusk.

quests.instruction: Tom hears the school bell, packs his bag, and goes home. What time of day is it right after?
quests.hint: Decide when school ends.
quests.explanation: After school ends, it is afternoon, when children go home and play.
quests.funFact: Some schools in very hot places start early so students can finish before the hottest part of the day.

quests.instruction: Sunrise, ____, sunset. Which fits in the blank?
quests.hint: The Sun is high between rise and set.
quests.explanation: Between sunrise and sunset, the Sun climbs to its highest, which is midday.
quests.funFact: The Sun reaches its highest point near midday, but not at exactly the same clock minute everywhere.

quests.instruction: Which comes first in the evening?
quests.hint: Remember the order of an evening.
quests.explanation: Dinner usually comes first in the evening, followed by bath, bed, and sleep.
quests.funFact: Some families like to cook dinner together.

quests.instruction: A boy puts on a coat, grabs a flashlight, and steps outside as the Sun is gone. What changed just before?
quests.hint: He needs the flashlight because of something that happened to the light.
quests.explanation: The flashlight shows that the Sun set and the sky became dark.
quests.funFact: After sunset it takes a while for the sky to be completely dark.

quests.instruction: Which comes right after night?
quests.hint: The cycle continues round and round.
quests.explanation: After night comes the morning, and a new day starts all over again.
quests.funFact: The cycle of day and night repeats every 24 hours.

quests.instruction: You see the Moon, then stars, then the sky starts to lighten. What happens next?
quests.hint: Light is returning.
quests.explanation: When the sky starts to lighten, sunrise is next, and a new day begins.
quests.funFact: After sunrise the sky keeps getting brighter.

quests.instruction: What happens right after you brush your teeth at bedtime?
quests.hint: It is almost the end of the day.
quests.explanation: After brushing your teeth, the next step is getting into bed to sleep.
quests.funFact: Your toothbrush needs to be replaced every few months.

quests.instruction: Which usually happens shortly before the afternoon begins?
quests.hint: Dinner is not before the afternoon.
quests.explanation: Lunch is eaten around the middle of the day, just before the afternoon begins. Dinner comes much later.
quests.funFact: The letters a.m. and p.m. come from Latin words meaning before midday and after midday.

quests.instruction: Which is the right order?
quests.hint: A day starts with waking up.
quests.explanation: A typical day starts with waking up, then school, then play, and ends with sleep.
quests.funFact: Each day has the same order of events, but the details change.

quests.instruction: The Sun is high, then lower, then gone. What do we call the last step?
quests.hint: The Sun is leaving.
quests.explanation: When the Sun disappears from the sky, that is sunset, the end of the daylight.
quests.funFact: Near the equator the Sun sets quickly, while farther north or south sunsets can take longer.

quests.instruction: What usually happens last at school?
quests.hint: The day is closing at school.
quests.explanation: The last thing at school is usually the final bell, which signals that students may go home.
quests.funFact: School bells can be loud so everyone can hear them.
